meta.name: The Mob
meta.description: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

videos.title: Kiss the Ring
videos.overview: Some of the most famous faces of celebrity and influencer culture come together in Italy to take part in a cutthroat game of social manipulation where power, loyalty, and respect are key to surviving each week and winning large amounts of money. After an explosive finish at the first Job, one Family member is anointed The Don, who must protect their position by rewarding loyalty and sniffing out threats. Back in the villa, the rest of the Family seeks attention, respect, and payment for doing their part in the Job. Some of the Family gets to know each other, while old feuds resurface for others. And while some reap rewards, others begin to question The Don’s motives. During the first Family Meeting, Family members try to uncover secrets.

videos.title: There's Always a Rat
videos.overview: During the Wine Bottling Job, Harry, Shane and Romeo show their strength…. and their muscles. While everyone works hard, Aida is loud. In his office, The Don questions the Family and cements his loyalties while other Family members’ bonds grow stronger. The Don’s motives and envelope distribution cause Maria, Harry, and Shane to plot their next move. Key information is shared with The Don, forcing some tough decisions. In the Family Meeting, everyone is stunned.

videos.title: This Is a Deadly Game
videos.overview: Conflicts come to a head at the Family meeting prompting Demi and Joe to regroup and strategize. During the Crime Scene Job, Romeo is faced with a tough task, leaving a majority of the Family members feeling jilted and wanting to take action. Maria and Shane must make a difficult decision that could derail others’ best laid plans. Demi reveals information to the Family and faces the consequences. The Don works to secure their position when faced with a demanding Family member. In the loyalty pledge, The Don faces questionable remarks leading to an unpredictable Family Meeting.

videos.title: Going to War
videos.overview: Family members rejoice after the game takes a shocking turn. In the Crate Packing Job, the Family scrambles to finish while Demi and Debi face their biggest test yet. Everyone is convinced Demi is the next to go home but she doesn’t go down without a fight. The Don keeps his promises, attempting to strengthen the bond with those in his corner and makes a surprising truce with a Family member. With everything at stake, Maria and Shane make a gut wrenching last minute decision. In the Family Meeting, the biggest shocking surprise awaits the Family and The Don.

videos.title: Turns Out, I Am That Bitch
videos.overview: Feeling down and out, Harry has a hard time trusting his confidants. In the Cooking Job, Shane and Harry add a special ingredient to the Don’s dish. The envelope distribution forces The Don to be transparent with The Family. With the numbers of the Family dwindling, everyone in the Villa is on edge. Fearful of losing one of its members, a powerful group makes a big decision. The Don receives some surprising information that could have major consequences. Words between Harry and Maria cause concern for their future. The Family Meeting unleashes the biggest surprise yet.

videos.title: I Can Spot a Fake From a Mile Away
videos.overview: The latest whacking surprises several Family members, and the result of the most recent Loyalty Pledge causes major shockwaves in the Villa, leaving some Family members feeling more powerful than ever while others are forced to rebuild their loyalties from the ground up. A slaughterhouse-set Job requires the Family to butcher their way to some cold hard cash. A disappointed Don grills the rest of the Family, and an ill-conceived bribe could land one Family member in the hot seat. With the numbers dwindling and the pressure mounting, each Family member does whatever it takes to avoid being the next person to be whacked.

videos.title: You Can Never Be Too Comfortable
videos.overview: It’s down to the remaining five Family members and the stakes have never been higher! In the Decoding Job, one Family member gets down and dirty to prove their worth to The Don. Doing everything possible to stay in the game, another Family member tries to get on The Don’s good side. And as tensions rise, everyone questions their loyalties and whether or not they will make it to the finale. No one is safe and no one can hide as The Don makes the biggest and deepest cut yet.

videos.title: What Would Tony Soprano Do?
videos.overview: The Family’s last Job is the biggest one yet, sending the final four Family members into the streets of a local Italian town in a mad scramble with the hopes of winning the largest amount yet - $100,000. With the end in sight, The Don must figure out how to protect their seat, as well as who to whack. Loyalty is put to the test as two Family members each make moves to usurp the Don’s seat in hopes of becoming the final Don. With the stakes at an all-time high, two questions will be answered - Who will be the final Don? And what will they ultimately do with the money - share with the Family, or steal it all for themselves.
